independence: Separate review context, same model family; no cross-family claim. Existing dogfood evidence was visible; code path reasoning was independently checked.

findings.title: Preserve the provider session when the V4 stop request fails
findings.trigger: A successfully created Browser Use browser is closed, but PATCH /api/v4/browsers/{id} fails with a transport error or HTTP 4xx/5xx.
findings.consequence: close reports success and permanently forgets the live cloud browser ID, so a second close cannot retry; the remote session can continue billing until provider-side expiry.
evidence: The changed V4 cleanup branch discards send() result and never checks response status.
actions.rs:2067-2070 takes active_provider_session before cleanup; the cleanup return type is ().
actions.rs:2074-2094 only returns an error from BrowserManager.close; browser.rs:1278-1299 deliberately sends no Browser.close for a remote CDP connection.
findings.scope: The branch now creates and retains Browser Use sessions; it exposes previously inert Browser Use cleanup code.

findings.title: Bound the new V4 create request before awaiting it under the daemon lock
findings.trigger: The provider HTTPS endpoint or a configured proxy accepts a connection but stalls before finishing the create response.
findings.consequence: open waits without a request deadline; it holds the daemon state mutex, preventing close, subsequent commands and idle/signal cleanup from progressing.
evidence: The new reqwest::Client::new() has no connect/request/read deadline, and .send().await and .text().await are unbounded.
daemon.rs:279,305,348 acquire the same mutex for shutdown/idle paths.
Existing exact-head dogfood.json independently records a 36-second stalled-proxy open, a blocked 5-second close, and a still-alive daemon after a configured 1-second idle budget.

additional_observations.title: A created session ID is discarded if cdpUrl is missing or malformed
additional_observations.evidence: parse_browser_use_connection extracts id but returns Err for missing/nonstring cdpUrl before constructing ProviderSession; both provider callers propagate connect errors without a cleanup handle.
additional_observations.limit: This requires malformed successful upstream data and is not a documented normal V4 response. No live provider fault injection was performed.

cleared: Both autolaunch and explicit-launch paths call stop when CDP attachment returns an error; absence of any such cleanup is not a valid finding.
V4 managed proxy null/direct mapping, lowercased country code, profileId and boolean enableRecording fields agree with the retained independent OpenAPI corpus.
Default idle shutdown intentionally permits provider-owned remote CDP sessions; lack of eligibility is not a valid finding.
The retained connect.browser-use.com text is historical CHANGELOG content, not an active provider contract.
validation: Read-only source trace across frozen diff, provider caller enumeration, lifecycle close path, daemon locking, and retained independent API corpus. No source edits or live provider calls.
